title: Prop configuration
description: Startup configuration, loaded by the interface (C6) at process start. Read by providers (C2), tools (C3), and sessions (C5).

preset.description: Provider preset (C2). Fills in kind, base_url, and context_window when omitted. The catalog includes the curated core, the full OpenAI-compatible models.dev set (the source OpenCode uses), and the local/custom entries; run `sudoer-prop --list-providers` for the authoritative ids.

kind.description: Which of the two Prop adapters to use (C2). Inferred from preset when omitted.

base_url.description: Endpoint for the OpenAI-compatible adapter; inferred from preset, otherwise required when kind is openai-compatible (C2).

api_key.description: Optional bearer credential for the endpoint (C2). Mutually exclusive with api_key_env; prefer the auth store (`sudoer-prop --setup`) or an env reference. Printable ASCII without whitespace; surrounding whitespace is trimmed, but an embedded newline or terminal transcript is rejected.

api_key_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the key (C2). Mutually exclusive with api_key. The name itself is not expanded.

model.description: Model name for the run (C2); selectable with --model or /model.

context_window.description: Model context size in tokens, used by context fitting (C4). With a preset, defaults to the catalog entry for the model, else 128000.

sampling.description: Optional sampling parameters for the configured model (C2), sent where the adapter supports them; omitted keys use the endpoint defaults.

workspace_root.description: Root that file tools and run_command are confined to (C3). Defaults to the process working directory when omitted; may be changed during a session via an interface command (C6).

session_dir.description: Directory holding persisted session files (C5). Defaults to ~/.config/sudoer/sessions (the app dir; $SUDOER_HOME moves it).

web.description: Network capability for the web tools (C3). Enabled and open by default; a denial is a hard block with no interactive override.

enabled.description: Master switch for web egress. When false the web tools are not assembled at all.

search_url.description: Base URL of the SearXNG (or compatible) backend used by web_search. When absent, web_fetch still works and web_search reports that it is unset.

deny_hosts.description: Hosts egress is blocked from. Empty by default (any host is allowed). An entry is an exact host or a `.`-prefixed suffix.

context.description: Context management (C4). `harness` (default) fits the prompt with the built-in clip/clear/fold ladder; `clm` mirrors the live context to an editable file the model manages itself (context as a file).

file.description: The live context file (CLM only). Relative paths resolve against workspace_root; defaults to <workspace_root>/.sudoer/context.md.

strategy.description: Optional natural-language context-management instruction (CLM only), appended to the CLM prompt section.
